item.title: Callahan's Restaurant serves its final meals after 42 years
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- For more than four decades, it's been a staple for those in Elkhart to dine, catch up, and be merry. But in just 12 days, Callahan's restaurant will serve its final meals.

item.title: Judge rules SBCSC does not have to sell Clay High School property to Charter Network
item.description: ST. JOSPEH COUNTY, Ind.— An administrative law judge in Indianapolis has ruled that the South Bend Community School Corporation does not have to sell the former Clay High School building to a charter school for one dollar, reversing an order from the Indiana Department of Education.

item.title: The Rev. Jesse Jackson’s local Impact in Benton Harbor
item.description: BENTON HARBOR, Mich. -- The Rev. Jesse L. Jackson, a civil rights leader, died Tuesday at the age of 84.

item.title: Joshua Jester sworn in as new Mishawaka Fire Chief
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- A swearing in ceremony was held Tuesday for newly appointed Fire Chief Joshua Jester.

item.title: Donald Shafer, Elkhart teacher facing child sex charges has initial court hearing
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- West Side Middle School teacher, Donald Shafer, had his initial court hearing on Tuesday at 1 p.m. The hearing was held in the Elkhart Correctional Complex courtroom.

item.title: Bethel University presents fourth annual Festival of Jazz and Jim Pickley Memorial Concert
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- Bethel University is holding its fourth annual Festival of Jazz and Jim Pickley Memorial Concert on Saturday, Feb. 21.

item.title: Starke County approves new moratoriums on solar projects, battery energy storage systems
item.description: STARKE COUNTY, Ind. -- The Starke County Commissioners unanimously approved two resolutions on Tuesday morning.

item.title: No. 7 Notre Dame sets program scoring record in 28-9 win over Bellarmine
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- The No. 7 Notre Dame men’s lacrosse team delivered a historic offensive performance Tuesday afternoon in its home opener, defeating Bellarmine 28-9 at Arlotta Stadium.

item.title: Barnaby’s in Mishawaka expands reach with frozen pizza shipping
item.description: MISHAWAKA, Ind. -- A longtime local pizza staple is finding new ways to reach customers beyond city limits as the restaurant industry navigates rising costs and the growing influence of digital ordering.

item.title: Community leaders address immigration concerns in Goshen
item.description: The Goshen City Democratic Party held a meeting on immigration on Tuesday evening.
